scope: Existing supplied screen-reference engineering assets and deterministic encoded derivatives. No optical camera, representative recognition, civil identity, hosted, device or release acceptance. No image/vector/template/credential payload.

encodings.A-0..2/B-0..2: RGB source; brightness factor1+index*.025; JPEG quality93-index
encodings.returning: RGB source A-0/B-0; brightness factor1.035; JPEG quality89
encodings.replacement: RGB source corresponding A-index/B-index; brightness factor1.015; JPEG quality91-index
encodings.P2/P4: white RGB1200x700 canvas; A/B each resized within330x330 maintaining aspect; offsets(150,180)/(800,180), P4 swaps positions; JPEG quality93

large_image_scope: large-2400 is a high upscale of the low-resolution source and neither original nor consumer detects a face; it checks consistent bounded decode/no-match behavior. small-face-2400 is a 2400x1600 canvas containing one detected small source face.
